articles.en: - This Law has the objective of managing pharmaceuticals in the Kingdom of Cambodia.

- Pharmaceuticals are substances, single or combined, of the following principal types: chemical substances, biological products, micro-organisms, plants, and mixtures prepared for: - use in the prevention or treatment of human or animal diseases; - medical or pharmaceutical research, or for diagnosis; - correcting or supporting the function of organs.
The following shall also be considered as pharmaceuticals:
1 - Serums or vaccines
2 - Blood or blood products
3 - Traditional medicines
4 - Products composed of toxic substances entered in a list determined by sub-decree.
may have the right to carry out the production, import-export and trade in pharmaceuticals, in respect of pharmacists having the following characteristics: - Cambodian nationality; - holding a pharmacist diploma recognised by the Ministry of Health; - never having been convicted of any criminal offence; - being in sufficient health to perform the work.
As for the production, import-export and trade in traditional medicines, this shall be determined by sub-decree.
1658 Chapter 2 Management of Toxic Substances Article 5.- Toxic substances refer to pharmaceuticals, substances, or compounds of substances or plants that may cause harm to health or cause addiction in humans or animals.
These toxic substances shall be determined by sub-decree.
Article 6.- The procedures and conditions for the production, import-export and trade in toxic substances shall be determined by sub-decree.
Chapter 3 Production, Import-Export and Trade in Pharmaceuticals. The procedures and technical conditions of production, and the operation of pharmaceutical manufacturing establishments,
shall be determined by sub-decree.
The Ministry of Health shall determine by its own Prakas: - the procedures and conditions for applying to open, close or relocate a pharmaceutical sales establishment, a pharmaceutical manufacturing establishment and a pharmaceutical import-export establishment; - the procedures and conditions for applying for a pharmaceutical licence and registration; - the procedures and technical conditions for the management and storage of pharmaceuticals; - the procedures and conditions for advertising pharmaceuticals; - as well as the procedures for the production, import-export and trade in pharmaceuticals.
The determination of the number of pharmaceutical sales establishments shall be made by the Ministry of Health on the basis of the number of inhabitants in the commune or sangkat concerned.
1659

-
1 - Authorization from the Ministry of Health shall be required for: - the opening, closing or relocation of a pharmaceutical sales establishment, a pharmaceutical import-export establishment and a pharmaceutical manufacturing establishment; - the conduct of business in the import-export of pharmaceuticals; - the import, export and storage of pharmaceuticals and of raw materials for pharmaceutical production; - the advertising of pharmaceuticals.
2 - The production, import-export and trade in veterinary pharmaceuticals shall be determined by a joint Prakas of the Ministry of Health and of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.
- 3 - A pharmaceutical sales establishment must have the presence of a pharmacist. In case of absence, a substitute having the qualifications determined by the Ministry of Health shall be present.
Chapter 4 Inspection, Guidance and Monitoring. The inspection, guidance and monitoring relating to pharmaceutical activities shall be the competence of the Ministry of Health.
As for the guidance and inspection of pharmaceutical categories for veterinary treatment, this shall be the competence of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.

shall be punished by a fine from 1,000,000 riels (one million riels) to
10,000,000 riels (ten million riels) and by suspension of production, import-export and trade in pharmaceuticals from 01 month to 03 months, or by either of the two penalties above, without prejudice to punishment for other offences, in respect of any person who has:
1 - Advertised pharmaceuticals without authorization from the Ministry of Health.
2 - Committed a breach of the procedures or conditions of production, import-export and trade in pharmaceuticals.
3 - Opened or relocated a pharmaceutical sales establishment or a pharmaceutical manufacturing establishment, or conducted business in the import-export of pharmaceuticals, without authorization from the Ministry of Health.
4 - Produced, or imported, or exported, or stored pharmaceuticals or pharmaceutical raw materials without authorization from the Ministry of Health.
5 - Sold pharmaceuticals without a licence or registration, or pharmaceuticals that the Ministry of Health has prohibited.
In the case of recidivism, the penalty of a fine and of suspension of production, import-export and trade in pharmaceuticals shall be doubled, or either of the two penalties
above.
Pharmaceuticals, raw materials, materials and equipment related to the offences provided in points 4 and 5 shall be confiscated as State property or destroyed.
The Ministry of Health shall have the right to suspend temporarily the advertising, production, import-export and trade in pharmaceuticals that are in breach, and to prepare a case file and send it to the court.

50,000,000 riels (fifty million riels), or by imprisonment from 05 years to 10 years, or by both penalties, in respect of any person who has produced, imported-exported or traded, intentionally, pharmaceuticals containing addictive substances without authorization, counterfeit pharmaceuticals, substandard pharmaceuticals, or expired pharmaceuticals, which affect the health or the life of users.
They shall be punished as provided in Articles 10, 11 and 12 in respect of any official who colludes or commits a breach in the performance of his or her duties in the implementation of Articles 10, 11 and 12.

_ Any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.
